title: fix(app-shell): permission matrix sets and shows readScope / writeScope (#26187)
body:
Part of #26187

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

PR 1 of 2 for #26187: the matrix editor. PR 2 wires `PermissionPreview` read-only into the permission-set and position pages, so #26187 remains open after this merges.

## What changes

- **Pickers in both renderers.** Every object row in Setup's `PermissionTable` and in Studio Access's `StudioObjectRow` gains a **Read scope** and a **Write scope** picker. Each picker is the shared `Select` that the facet pickers use (objectui#11865). It lists "Not set" plus the five `ObjectAccessScopeSchema` values in the spec's order. A pick writes the key through a new mutator, `updateObjectScope`. "Not set" deletes the key. Every other key of the row rides through.
- **Hierarchy hint.** `own_and_reports`, `unit` and `unit_and_below` show the hint "requires enterprise; otherwise owner-only" on their items, and stay selectable. Per the seat's ruling, the hint is unconditional: no client signal says whether `hierarchy-security` is licensed.
- **Greying.** These are the #16870 pairs, mirrored from the server and not decided by the client. View All disables the read picker. Modify All disables both pickers. Each disabled trigger carries the reason as its `title`.
- **Clearing rule.** Granting View All drops `readScope`. Granting Modify All drops both scopes. One helper, `dropScopesBypassedBySuperUserBits`, applies the rule in the per-checkbox cascade and in the "All" bulk arm. On `origin/main`, both paths saved a row that the BASE schema refuses. Effective access does not change: the resolvers answer `org` on the super-user bit before they read a scope.
- **Types and vocabulary.** `ObjectPerm` gains `readScope?` / `writeScope?`, typed with the spec's `ObjectAccessScope`. The boolean columns get their own type, `ObjectPermFlag`, so a checkbox can no longer address a scope key. `OBJECT_ACCESS_SCOPES` restates the five values with a type-only import. The reason is the one `useTenancyPosture` documents: the `@objectstack/spec/security` value entry costs about 237 KB of bundle. A test compares the list with `ObjectAccessScopeSchema.options`. `HIERARCHY_SCOPES` is typed with the spec's `HierarchyScope`.
- **Strings.** The new strings live only in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`perm.scope.*`, en + zh). The column headers reuse `engine.permissionPreview.readScope` / `writeScope`. No `ui/packages/i18n` locale pack is touched.

## How the greying covers the two bulk paths (the card's question)

- **"All"** grants View All and Modify All, so it now drops both scopes, the same as the per-checkbox cascade. After the click the row holds Modify All, so both pickers are greyed. `allowExport` and any other unauthored key still ride through, as #6605 requires. `PermissionMatrixEditor.bulkMergeKeys.test.tsx` flips its two "All" pins (environment door and package door) from "keeps `readScope: 'own'`" to "drops both scopes".
- **"None"** is unchanged: it replaces the row with `{}`, scopes included (the #6605 fence). No super-user bit remains, so both pickers are open and show "Not set".
- **"CRUD" / "R"** reset View All and Modify All, and the scopes ride through. Those pins are kept as they were.

## Evidence

All figures are from `ui/` vitest on this branch, run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- **Red first.** The three implementation files (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `permission-slice.ts`, `i18n.ts`) were set back to `origin/main` `df8aac41` (hash-equal to the BASE blobs, 0 `perm-scope-` markers). The new and flipped suites then gave `Tests 17 failed | 5 passed (22)`. All 15 behaviour pins of `recordScope-26187` failed, and so did both "All" pins of `bulkMergeKeys`. The 5 that stayed green are expected: the BASE-schema refusal control, the "other column leaves the scopes alone" preservation pin, and the CRUD / R / None pins. The restore was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- **Ablation.** The "All"-arm `dropScopesBypassedBySuperUserBits(next);` was deleted once with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 → x0, blob `b275ac54` → `d01962e8`). `bulkMergeKeys` then gave `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`: both "All" pins failed and CRUD / R / None stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Round trip at both doors.** A picked value is saved, then reopened from the saved record, at the environment door (`client.save` with no draft mode). At the package door, the autosaved draft goes through `mergePermissionSlice`, and an out-of-scope row from another package comes back byte for byte. The saved rows after the View All and Modify All ticks are checked with the spec's real `ObjectPermissionSchema.safeParse`, not with a restatement of its rule.

## Tests (local, each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`)

- `recordScope-26187`, `bulkMergeKeys` and `retiredLifecycleKeys`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 26 passed (26)` at `93c9211e`. The later merge of `origin/main` (`c696351d`) touched none of the seven files in this diff.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both tsc programs) at `c696351d`, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (64/64 tasks): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The full app-shell suite (1,740 files at `--maxWorkers=2`) is **NOT MEASURED**. I stopped my own run after about 50 minutes without a verdict, because it was holding the shared lock. Declared narrowing: the 195 app-shell test files that import the editor, `permission-slice` or the metadata-admin `i18n`, plus the Studio Access suites. That set was still queued for the lock when this PR was opened, so its result goes in the `os-dev-report` comment on #26187. CI's `Test UI` runs its affected selection over this diff.

## Gates at `c696351d` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, every command run and reconciled with `--ran`)

- 35 families derived and recorded with exit codes: 34 exited 0, including `check-sdui-manifest` (0, the manifest is untouched), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias` and `check:type-check-coverage`.
- `check:type-check-debt` is **NOT MEASURED** (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`): its closure build timed out in the shared lock's queue. CI runs it in `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- Changed lines: 666 (+624 / -42) over 7 files.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** `PermissionMatrixEditor.retiredLifecycleKeys.test.tsx` pinned the header strip as `slice(1, -1)`. The two new columns made that pin false, so it now reads `slice(1, -3)` and also pins the two scope headers. The claim's file surface did not list this file.
- **Stored pre-#16870 pair (not changed here).** A row stored before #16870 can hold View All plus `readScope`. Such a row loads with the read picker greyed and showing the stored value. Saving it unchanged sends the pair, and the server refuses it, as it does on `origin/main`. The matrix does not strip the key on load, because that would delete stored data without the admin acting. To clear it, untick View All, set "Not set", then tick View All again. This is in the report's open questions.
- **"Only granted" and the granted count (observation, not filed).** Both count a row with any truthy key as granted (`Object.values(perm).some(Boolean)`). A row that carries only a scope is therefore listed. This was already true on `origin/main` for `allowExport` and for scopes set through the API. It is noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.*` is untouched (app-shell is outside the sdui registry closure). `check-sdui-manifest` exits 0.
